docs.title: LinkML Microschema Profile
docs.text:
A LinkML schema defining the Microschema Profile for composable data elements. Microschemas are designed for inline composition without identifiers. Domain-specific record and example microschemas live in downstream schemas (e.g., https://w3id.org/linkml/clinical-microschemas).

URI: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-microschema-profile

Name: linkml-microschema-profile
